title: On a temporary lighter plan: the kickoff asks for the lighter step, not the usual one
origin: Issue #196 (coverage gap: a temporary lighter plan in progress)

history.text: at my sister's wedding all weekend, can we go lighter till Monday?
Course, Ana. 10 push-ups and 10 squats a day through Sunday, then back to the full 20 minutes Monday. Enjoy the wedding 💃

plan.reason: Something small keeps the habit alive while you're away.

temporary.usual_step: 20 min: 4 rounds of 10 push-ups and 15 squats

step_days.step: 20 min: 4 rounds of 10 push-ups and 15 squats

testerLines: yep, in my hotel room now
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: no case started on a temporary lighter plan.
shouldHaveHappened: The kickoff names the lighter step (10 push-ups and 10 squats), not the usual 20 minutes, without guilt and without pushing for more; it may mention the full plan coming back Monday, in a few words. Her yes gets a short, warm reply and no second question.
